profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at RapidSOS
profile.summary:
Experienced Frontend Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the financial services and public safety industries. Skilled in Web Design, Management, and Front-end Development. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Computer Science from New York University. 

Unsolicited calls or texts to my phone, will be blocked and reported as spam.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and shipped real-time bidirectional SMS messaging features for mission-critical communications, including text-from-911 and text-to-911
- Architected and shipped a new runtime feature-flag system end to end, including proxy delivery for firewall networks and QA override tooling
- Built a contract-testing framework that runs against a real backend runtime, catching integration breaks before they reach production, enforced in CI.

positions.title: Front End Developer II
positions.description:
- Implemented real-time location updates for emergency alerts on ESRI and Google Maps, enabling real-time tracking during emergencies
- Created live streaming functionalities with playback analytics, providing operators with valuable insights for real-time decision-making and incident investigation
- Streamlined emergency response by implementing a system for operators to create train-specific emergencies based on IDs and departure times
- Built real-time WebSocket functionalities for data sharing, alert updates, and seamless reconnections, empowering on-site emergency services with continuous information
- Ensured consistency across maps by migrating geolocation features from Google API to Deck.gl, maintaining a seamless user experience
- Developed business-specific alerts that prioritize user privacy by obfuscating precise coordinates while providing a visual radius of the emergency location within a building
- Led comprehensive codebase modernization effort, unlocking critical version upgrades for performance and longevity of main applications

positions.title: Software Development Engineer - II
positions.description:
- Developed a new payment feature which has evolved into a micro front-end and is now being utilized across multiple projects, ultimately contributing $2MM in revenue within the first three months
- Crafted and implemented silent authorization across front-end applications to enable a global consistent experience
- Standardized UI/UX designs across applications by creating an internal open-source component library, thereby driving increased collaboration and alignment with UX designers
- Ensure code hygiene and quality assurance via code reviews, resilient test scripts, and developer pairing to meet target release timeframes
- Created a shared module for core utilities and now fully integrated into our project template repository
- Manage new developers, interns, and consultants to ensure smooth integration into various projects

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
-Developed onsite mobile ticketing application for BODIES exhibition
-Worked alongside designers and back-end developers to ensure a smooth intuitive product
-Improved turnaround time of ticket redeeming by 60%
-Implemented ticket validation preventing multiple ticket uses
-Coded in hybrid language, Flutter

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
-Worked with client to update preexisting site to match changes needed
-Dynamic Rebass (React library) application
-Received and completed priority changes within 2 weeks
-Communicated with original designer and project leader

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
-Responsive React web application
-Worked with and implemented designs provided
-Firebase for specific data to allow site changes without the need of a developer
-Mobile Friendly

positions.title: Head of Grading
positions.description:
-Management and training of over 20+ TAs each semester
-Department is responsible for over 300+ incoming freshman per semester
-Secured an increase of over 20% worth of responsibilities for the department
-Constant finding and solving problems within 24 hours to ensure smooth course for students
-Overhauled the way files are organized for intuitive file searching

positions.title: Deputy Grading Auditor
positions.description:
-General Engineering Department
Administrative role in the General Engineering Department
Work with professors and other committees to run EG smoothly
Responsible for overseeing the grading teaching assistants for all sections of the course
Ensure grading rubric are fair and challenges the students

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
-General Engineering Department
-Worked with peers to provide students a healthy learning environment
-Increased student comprehension of software and materials
-100% rate of students completing Semester Long Project On-time

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
-HTML, CSS, JQuery, C#, SQL
-Discovered, worked with project leaders, and fixed flaw in XML
format preventing possible project delay by 3 weeks.
-Developed internal admin page crucial to companies growing
client-base
-Developed easy to read and reusable functions

honors.title: Moffly's Light a FIre Outstanding Teen Volunteer
honors.description: Moffly Media, a organizations which owns many magazines in Fairfield County, honors 8 people once a year who dedicate their time to helping others in their community.

volunteerExperiences.description:
-Received extensive knowledge about STDs, HIV, and Teen Pregnancy
-Held lectures for peers interested in learning about safe sex
-Acted as a confidential resource for those seeking help
-Worked closely with Greenwich Health Department

-Administrative role over Facebook page
-Communicated with all members at any point in time
-Created meeting notes to be emailed to all members
-Participated in the creation of meeting discussion points
